frozen_claims.text: On the object axis: their account holds that quantifies over mental STATES: a state is conscious iff accompanied by a distinct, usually unconscious HOT; trika-x holds that quantifies over SELF-POSITIONING: what changes in recognition. This matters because the theories do not range over the same entities; a state-level predicate has no counterpart in trika-x.

On the change axis: their account holds that consciousness requires an ADDED higher-order state; trika-x holds that recognition adds no content and preserves what is there. This matters because if mapped, the two contradict: addition vs non-addition.

On the self axis: their account holds that the self is a construction (a model built from HOTs); trika-x holds that the 'I'-grasp is not a construction (IPVV V2L, R-tier). This matters because whether selfhood is explained or presupposed: a model built from HOTs vs an unconstructed self-grasp.

Their formalisation is: Higher-Order Thought theory (Rosenthal): a state is conscious iff accompanied by a higher-order representation of it (Rosenthal: a mental state is conscious iff accompanied by a HOT to the effect that one is in that state; HOTs are distinct, typically unconscious states (reportability + fineness-of-grain arguments). Verified from Rosenthal's texts (davidrosenthal.org) and Scholarpedia, 2026-11-17.). Recorded as published; not re-verified by this essay.
Our side is anchored in machine-checked structures: Recognition.lean :: recognition_adds_nothing. Registry references are not source-to-theorem entailments.

Obstruction: Different objects of quantification: HOT is a predicate on mental states; trika-x has no state-consciousness layer and no meta-representation relation. Encoding HOT would require adding a state ontology that the affirmative Trika account does not contain.
Shared ground: a reflective or self-referential element is central.
Shared ground: the 'I'-grasp is not itself constructed.
What it means: A paper can say precisely why HOT and Trika cannot be compared head-on, and why 'recognition adds nothing' is not a HOT variant.
